name: TCL Taobao · Chrome desktop
postCreateCommand: test "$(dpkg --print-architecture)" = amd64 || { echo 'Google Chrome stable requires an amd64 Codespace'; exit 1; }; d=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT; curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 3 https://dl.google.com/linux/direct/google-chrome-stable_current_amd64.deb -o "$d/chrome.deb"; sudo apt-get update -qq; sudo apt-get install -y "$d/chrome.deb"; python -m pip install playwright==1.62.0; google-chrome-stable --version
